THE CHALLENGE

​80% of recombinant protein expression programs fail to express at meaningful levels or scale efficiently.

THE SOLUTION

Increase your chances of success with MNDL Bio’s host-optimized DNA sequence engineering.
Reduce R&D timelines and costs by moving from trial & error experimentation to predictive, data-driven, in-silico design.

Learn More
THE IMPACT
Achieve up to 30× higher protein yields with MNDL Bio’s AI-driven DNA engineering.*

*Results depend on protein, host, and production context.

What MNDL Bio Delivers

MNDL Bio provides host-optimized DNA sequences designed to improve yield, genetic stability, and other critical production metrics, while preserving the original protein amino-acid sequence.

Whole-construct DNA engineering
for expression success and scale

Learn More

Broad Host Compatibility

Validated across major expression systems. New host organisms can be supported in silico in under 48 hours.

Synthesis-Ready

Output DNA sequences are validated and instantly ready for synthesis.

Secure & Confidential

Proprietary DNA sequences & project data remain protected & fully under your control.

OUR TECHNOLOGY

A FUSION OF PHYSICS & AI

Proprietary biophysical models, developed and validated over more than 15 years, guide machine learning to enable reliable gene expression design, even in data-limited search spaces.
